name: Bia hoi
summary: Bia hơi is Hanoi’s fresh draft beer. Vietnam Tourism says the beer is unpasteurized and drunk soon after it is made, and calls a glass as light as water.
origin: Hanoi. Vietnam Tourism’s Old Quarter article calls the sidewalk beer a local habit. The corner is the place. The beer is the drink.
howToEat: Drink it fresh. Vietnam Tourism’s street-food walk says it is unpasteurized and consumed soon after production.
Vietnam Tourism’s Old Quarter article sits you on a stool at the beer corner. A drink price is not printed here.
where: Tạ Hiện and Lương Ngọc Quyến, the beer corner the tourism pages name. The hour is Check on arrival.
